facts.name: William L. Roby
facts.assignment: Circuit profile and Martin roster still list Roby and civil-jury procedures. Governor lists retirement vacancy as Appointed. Current service is not confirmed; retain published contact/procedure evidence with this qualification.

contact.contact_note: As published on circuit profile; current-service discrepancy recorded. No fax published in reviewed profile/roster.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant PDFs with case number/name and subject; copy all parties. No private messages through staff.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first and coordinate; book UMC and special sets up to one hour online, longer settings by assistant email. Cancel online, file notice and email copy. UMC length varies within page; see recorded discrepancy.

conferral.summary: Profile requires meaningful personal conferral and signed hearing-notice certification; email alone is insufficient.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word order with attorney-signed cover letter and complete email/postal service list. UMC orders required before hearing; special-set advance orders preferred. Requested orders circulated within two business days and submitted within seven with objections identified.

courtesy_copies.summary: Paperless PDF email; special-set materials ten business days before hearing, general materials five. More than ten pages on delivered/mailed flash drive; no hardcopy binders. Simultaneous copy to other parties.

remote_appearances.summary: Profile permits Zoom for UMC, nonevidentiary special sets and case management; evidentiary hearings/trials in person. Notify all parties three business days before remote appearance.

facts.summary: Practical published civil operating instructions retained; current service qualified by governor vacancy evidence. No merits or motion-specific litigation recipes abstracted.

conflicts.subject: Current service
statements: Governor index identifies retirement vacancies for Roby and Roberts and marks Appointed; linked August19 letter appoints Jeffrey Hendriks to Nineteenth Circuit, subject to filing qualifying papers.
conflicts.disposition: Preserve both; letter alone does not establish assumption date or current county assignment.

conflicts.subject: UMC duration
statements: Later paragraph limits five minutes per case.
conflicts.disposition: Internal difference preserved without choosing controlling statement.

gaps: Current-service and successor county assignment remain unconfirmed; successor must be reconciled in county roster.
Fax not published in reviewed profile/roster.

review_scope.not_reviewed: Motion-specific merits/trial recipes, calendars and forms; printable duplicate procedures linked only.
